rendered:
The V2O5 film thicknesses tested electrochemically were 80 nm and 40 nm. 
80 nm film was achieved with 1000 ALD cycles. 
40 nm film was achieved with 500 ALD cycles. 
The potential shifts differed between the 80 nm and 40 nm V2O5 films, with similar shifts in values of ΔEeq(avg) observed for both films owing to the similar % “locked in” elastic strains.

expect: ~80 nm (1000 ALD cycles, Fig. 3 caption p4.L61) and ~40 nm; similar ΔEeq(avg) shifts (~40 mV) for both, owing to similar locked-in strains (p4.L40-44)
question: Which V2O5 film thicknesses were tested electrochemically, how many ALD cycles gave the thicker film, and did the potential shifts differ between them?
